title: LLM-as-a-Judge is Bad, Based on AI Attempting the Exam Qualifying for the Member of the Polish National Board of Appeal

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the automated grading scores produced by an LLM against the baseline assessments of an expert human examining committee to identify systematic divergences, specifically finding that the LLM consistently overvalued stylistic conformity and verbosity while being overly lenient on fatally flawed substantive legal reasoning.
